steps.label: operate_native_rider_impact_two
steps.objective: Do two riders resolve impacts and expend their own ammunition correctly? Use the two-lane controlled footing, identify each rider and give both a real firing opportunity. Preserve native damage and let the selected exchange resolve. Success boundary: Each attack belongs to the correct actor; impacts and finite ammunition are accounted independently, including misses, interruptions and player defeat.
proof_targets: fresh closing approach and later impact opportunity
independent two-rider pressure and one-attack arbitration
invariants: no debug attack or target injection
no stationary adjacency credited as closing
no bite-only contact credited as impact
cooldown does not re-arm without a fresh closing step
no same-turn extra strike after impact

evidence_contract.claim: two current native zombie riders produce named physical impact outcomes with cooldown/re-approach and independent one-attack arbitration
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native closing receipts and named impact messages are required

playtest_recipe.title: Two riders attack independently
playtest_recipe.question: Do two riders resolve impacts and expend their own ammunition correctly?

starting_state.guidance: Use the declared coherent footing for this executable route. The standard house is the default adaptation for fire, camp and human interaction questions; it is not a substitute for a specific retained state or controlled diagnostic. Preserve owner originals.

playtest_recipe.exercise: Use the two-lane controlled footing, identify each rider and give both a real firing opportunity. Preserve native damage and let the selected exchange resolve.
controls: play look — identify the current input owner and relevant scene.
play controls — obtain current native actions and copyable movement/wait requests.
play act ACTION [--target STABLE_ID] — select an advertised action; use live IDs, not historical examples.
play wait 5m safe — example of a batched native wait, not a required interval. Choose duration and safe/stop/ignore for the actual question; ignore can allow injury or death.
For movement, use the advertised game.move_relative request through play call --request REQUEST.json, or native overmap travel for a usable route. Stop at a decision, obstruction or danger.
play collect — collect an outstanding request instead of submitting it again.
play inspect SELECTOR — retrieve the relevant field from the returned evidence handle.
playtest_recipe.batching: Batch to the next useful observation or decision, not to a prescribed command count. Read menu replies before choosing targets. Preserve pending request IDs; inspect partial progress and continue the same request when appropriate. Read-only observations do not advance game time.
playtest_recipe.success: Each attack belongs to the correct actor; impacts and finite ammunition are accounted independently, including misses, interruptions and player defeat.
playtest_recipe.failure: A reproducible contradiction under the stated opportunity is a finding. Preserve the first divergence and distinguish product behavior from setup, transport or stale-input faults. Do not force the expected outcome.
playtest_recipe.inconclusive: Missing source, observer, reachability, elapsed time or current input ownership leaves that part unproved. Repair incidental setup in the current run where possible; do not substitute an easier endpoint.
playtest_recipe.evidence: Use play controls evidence_logs and the actual returned selectors. Record selected source/build, run and actor/site IDs, game-time endpoints and the decisive native events. Correlate emission, receipt, decision and physical action when relevant; a log label or spoken success alone is insufficient.
playtest_recipe.finish: Save useful unfinished state through the native save action. When the run is settled, close its game/helpers, verify exit and delete generated saves/logs/captures and temporary declarations. Keep owner originals and concise current findings; no archive.
playtest_recipe.reuse: Update this recipe with proven setup, controls and diagnostic queries that change future decisions. Replace obsolete advice. Keep live IDs and one-run chronology out; prior success is scoped evidence, not a current-build guarantee.
